- Inspections are created automatically when you add systems, but you can also add your own.

Befaringer gjennomføres på mobil, nettbr:
Inspections are carried out on a phone, tablet or PC – also offline.

• Types: pre-lease inspection, handover, tenant fit-out, tenant maintenance obligations (checkpoints from the split of responsibility in the lease), return of premises (compared with the handover), energy waste hunt, ad hoc round, system registration in a new building, health and safety inspection and warranty inspection.
• Checkpoints: answer OK, Deviation, Remark or N/A (not applicable), with comments and photos. «Deviation» opens a finding.
• Drawing and findings: choose «New finding» and tap the floor plan. Measure distance and area, draw, add arrows and text. If the drawing has no scale, set it with two points and a known distance.
• Findings of the deviation type become ordinary deviations with responsibility (owner/operations, tenant, shared, supplier), deadline and status, and can be sent as a work order. System registration adds the system to the TFM register.
• Report and signing: create a PDF and send it for signing by e-mail (personal link and one-time code) or sign on site. When everyone has signed, the signed report is saved under Documents.
• Offline: everything is saved on the device and synced automatically when the connection is back. Use «Prepare for offline» to download the drawings in advance. If you log out, data on the device is deleted – you are warned first about unsynced inspections.
Samlet oversikt over befaringsrapporter:

One round in the building for everything that needs doing: self-inspections, fire doors and emergency lighting, meter readings and deviations assigned to you.

• The items are grouped by place – the area on the drawing where the system or component is (or proximity if areas have not been drawn) – and sorted floor by floor in a suggested walking order.

• Allocation per tenant: link sub-meters to a tenant and a main meter. Consumption per tenant is then shown for any period, together with what the sub-meters do not capture. Can be exported to Excel.

- The coverage matrix shows what exists, is missing or has expired.
- When you register systems that require a service agreement (e.g. sprinklers, fire alarm, lift), a check appears here.

Hver kunde er en organisasjon: gårdeier,:
Each customer is an organisation: property owner, property management company, facility operator or service company. Users only see data they have been given access to, and the rules are enforced in the database.

- Users and assignment: add employees with a role (administrator, property manager, operations technician, reader) and decide which buildings or portfolios each person works with. «All buildings» gives access to everything the organisation has, including new buildings.

A portfolio is a group of buildings with the same owner, e.g. «City centre», «Business park» or a separate property company. An owner can have many portfolios.

- Give a property management company an assignment for a whole portfolio – new buildings added to the portfolio are included automatically.
- Assign your own employees a portfolio instead of individual buildings.
- The overview shows statistics per owner and portfolio: deviations, overdue inspections, condition, backlog, replacement needs over 10 years and document coverage.
Gårdeier bestemmer hvem utenfor egen org:
The owner decides who outside their own organisation can see the buildings:

- Management: the company can edit everything, like your own property manager.
- Operations: sees the whole building, carries out inspections and handles deviations, but does not change systems, tenants or finances.
- Service: sees only the selected systems (with inspections, deviations and O&M for these) and records completed service.
- View: can view, not change.

The company's own administrator assigns the buildings to its employees. If the assignment is ended or expires, the whole company loses access immediately. The company cannot pass the access on.

Forskrift om brannforebygging § 4 sier a:
The Norwegian fire prevention regulations § 4 say that the owner must know the fire safety requirements in the building, make the tenants aware of them and coordinate the use when several businesses rent in the building. Under § 10 the owner must be able to document that this has been done.

How it works:
- Fire card: fill in the risk class, assumptions from the fire strategy, alarm organisation, fire brigade access area, house rules, and choose the evacuation plans to attach.
- Fetch from fire strategy: if the fire strategy has been uploaded as a PDF (type «Fire strategy/fire safety documentation»), the app can read it and suggest risk class, fire class (also per floor), special fire object, number of persons, alarm, fire alarm panel, fire brigade access area and assumptions. The text is read in the browser and is not sent anywhere. Each suggestion is shown with page and excerpt and must be approved. Scanned PDFs without text cannot be read.
- Publish: each publication gets a version number. If you change the fire card later (alterations, a new fire strategy, a new access area), you publish a new version, and all tenants must receive and confirm it again.
- Fire safety pack: the app creates a PDF per tenant with the building's fire safety, the installations (including components placed in the tenant's area on the drawing), house rules, the tenant's obligations under §§ 11–13 and a signature page. The pack is added to the tenant's documents and shown in the portal.
- Confirmation: the tenant confirms in the portal. If the tenant has no login, you can record a signed paper or an e-mail. The confirmation must be renewed every year.
- Reduced fire safety: if the alarm is out of service, an escape route is closed or the sprinklers are disconnected, you notify the tenants. The notice is shown at the top of the portal until it is ended, and you can see who has read it.
- Coordination: the overview shows the fire safety manager, coordination agreement and latest fire drill per tenant, and you can add a joint annual fire drill to the inspection plan.

The tenant's own obligations (routines, training, drills) are followed up as before under Internal control and obligations.
Her ser du leieavtalen din, hva du som l: Here you see your lease, what you as a tenant are responsible for, and which obligations you must document (e.g. internal control and fire safety manager). Upload documentation and confirm when an obligation has been fulfilled.
TFM (tverrfaglig merkesystem) gir hvert:
TFM (the Norwegian cross-disciplinary labelling system) gives every system and component a unique code, e.g. =360.001-JV001:

- =360 is the system code from NS 3451 (360 = air handling).
- .001 is the sequence number of the system in the building.
- -JV001 is the component code (JV = fan) and sequence number.

The first digit of the system code is the main group: 2 Building, 3 HVAC and plumbing, 4 Electrical power, 5 Telecom and automation, 6 Other installations, 7 Outdoor.
Teknisk levetid er hvor lenge en bygning:
Technical service life is how long a building element works before it must be replaced. Functional service life is how long it meets the need (requirements, use, energy) before it should be replaced, even if it still works.

The app suggests service life from an NS 3451 reference table. Use the technical service life as a starting point, and the functional one where requirements or use change quickly. You can always override it.
Nåverdi er hva en fremtidig kostnad er v:
Present value is what a future cost is worth today. It answers the question: how much must I set aside today to have enough money when the replacement comes?

- First the cost is price-adjusted with the CPI up to the replacement year («Cost at replacement»).
- Then it is discounted back to today with the discount rate: present value = future cost ÷ (1 + rate)^number of years.
- The present value is lower than today's cost when the rate is higher than inflation, because the money you set aside can earn a return in the meantime.

Example: A replacement costing 712,880 in 2038 has a present value of approx. 354,000 at a 6 % rate. If you set aside 354,000 today and get a 6 % return every year, you will have 712,880 in 2038.

Present value makes it possible to compare and add up replacements that happen in different years, e.g. to assess what the maintenance backlog is worth today or how much should be set aside. The discount rate is set under Settings.
Kostnader legges inn i kroneverdien for: Costs are entered in the money value of a specific year (price level). Up to the replacement year they are adjusted with the CPI rate from Settings, so that «cost at replacement» shows the expected price in that year.

The condition grade says how bad something is; the consequence grade says how much it matters.

Enter the make and model and tap «Search for service life and cost». The app uses Google Gemini to find the supplier's stated service life and an estimate of the replacement and retrofit cost.

- The Use buttons put the values into the form. Costs are marked SUGGESTION.
- If Google search is not available, the model answers from general knowledge. A warning is then shown, and the uncertainty is high.
- Always check costs against quotes.
Tagger som Brann, HVAC, Elektro og Bygni: Tags such as Fire, HVAC, Electrical and Building are used to filter the register and the drawings. A system gets suggested tags based on its type. Components inherit the system's tags but can have their own.

Common area (corridors, toilets, technical rooms) is allocated to the tenants by share of rentable area.

If the lease fixes the common area (as m², a percentage of the common area or a percentage add-on), it is compared with the actual figure. The difference is over- or under-coverage and can be shown in money.
Noen av eiers kontroller er koblet til l:
Some of the owner's inspections are linked to the tenants' obligations, for example «Obtain confirmation of the tenant's internal control and maintenance» and «Fire drill – coordinated evacuation drill».

- Each active tenant on the property is shown as a sub-item with its obligations.
- A sub-item is green when all relevant obligations have been confirmed in the period (since the last sign-off) and are not overdue.
- When all tenants are green, the inspection is signed off automatically and the next deadline is set.
- Confirmations can be recorded by the owner/property manager, or by the tenant in the tenant portal.
- Obligations marked «Not relevant» for a tenant are not counted.
En kontroll kan sendes som arbeidsordre:
An inspection can be sent as a work order by e-mail to the service company, either manually («Send work order» in the inspection) or automatically a chosen number of days before the deadline.

- The work order contains the property and address, system (TFM), deadline, basis (legal basis) and the checkpoints from «Notes / checkpoints».
- The service company gets a link where they record the completion date, result and deviations and upload the service report and photos – without creating a user.
- The report is added to the inspection as «For approval» and shown under «Requires action now» on the overview. You approve (the inspection is recorded as completed, the files are saved as a service report, deviations are created) or reject.

Automatic sending: turn on «Send automatically before deadline» under «Edit» on the inspection and choose the number of days. Sending runs every morning. It is sent once per deadline; when the inspection is recorded as completed and gets a new deadline, the next work order is sent automatically before it.

The service company's e-mail can also be entered on the system («E-mail to service company»), and is then used for all inspections on the system. The e-mail is sent from the organisation's settings under Administration → Settings.
Kontraktstype og ansvarsfordeling: Lease type and split of responsibility
Kontraktstypen bestemmer hvem som har an:
The lease type determines who is responsible for operation and maintenance and who is responsible for replacement, area by area. It governs which obligations the tenant gets and who holds the inspections on the systems.

- Standard lease for premises: the owner has the building, shared installations and replacement; the tenant has interior maintenance within the premises.
- Triple net: the tenant operates and maintains the building and the technical installations, the owner replaces. A variant lets the owner keep the roof, façade and structure.
- Bare house: the tenant has both maintenance and replacement, also on the exterior. The owner only replaces the load-bearing structures.
- Custom: fill in as the lease says.

Leases vary, so each item can be adjusted. Items that differ from the template get a yellow frame, and you can enter the clause of the lease (e.g. § 9.2). A split you use several times can be saved with «Save as own template».

«Owner, tenant pays» means the owner carries out the work and re-invoices, common in triple net.

Tap «Update obligations and inspections» to apply the split. You first see what will change and can untick what should be left untouched:
- New obligations are added, e.g. service agreements, inspection of fire and electrical installations, exterior maintenance and a replacement plan.
- Systems covered get new responsibility for operation and replacement, and the inspections are moved to the tenant or back to the owner.

Systems are covered when they are linked to the tenant («Serves tenant» on the system), or all systems when the tenant rents the whole building. The link between system and area goes via the NS 3451 code.
Sende sjekklisten til leietaker: Sending the checklist to the tenant
På leietakersiden trykker du «Send sjekk:
On the tenant page, tap «Send checklist to tenant». The tenant receives an e-mail with a link.

- The first time, the tenant creates a user via the link. The user only gives access to their own tenancy.
- In the portal the tenant fills in the checklist for each obligation, attaches documentation and submits.
- Submitted obligations get the status «For approval» and are shown under «Requires action now» on the overview.
- Tap «Review» to approve, or «Send back» with an explanation of what is missing. The tenant sees the feedback in the portal.
- When you approve, the obligation counts as documented. When all tenants are documented, the owner's inspection is signed off automatically.
Hver plikt har en sjekkliste over dokume: Each obligation has a checklist of the documentation that should be obtained from the tenant, for example fire instructions, the participant list from a fire drill or the risk assessment in the health and safety internal control. Tick off as the documentation comes in, and attach the files. You are warned if you record an obligation as documented without all items being ticked.
Brannøvelser – hva krever regelverket?: Fire drills – what do the regulations require?
Forskrift om brannforebygging § 12 påleg:
The Norwegian fire prevention regulations § 12 require the business using the building to carry out systematic fire safety work, with routines for knowledge about fire, fire instructions for alerting, evacuation/rescue and extinguishing, and fire drills and training of all employees. Under § 13 this must be documented.

- The regulations do not set a fixed number of drills. Scope and frequency must be adapted to the risk and how complex the building is. At least one drill a year is common practice, and often more for buildings with many people or vulnerable users.
- In buildings with several tenants, drills must be coordinated between the owner and the tenants (internal control regulations § 6, Working Environment Act § 2-2).
- The app therefore has both an obligation for each tenant («Fire drill carried out and employees trained») and an inspection for the owner («Fire drill – coordinated evacuation drill for the building») that shows the status for each tenant.

Always check against the current regulations and DSB's guidance.
Når du legger til et system, foreslår ap:
When you add a system, the app suggests inspections based on the system type: statutory inspections (e.g. annual inspection of fire alarm, sprinklers, emergency lighting, lift), self-inspections (e.g. monthly test of emergency lighting, weekly sprinkler check) and service according to the supplier's recommendation. Legal basis and interval are shown under each inspection.

- All are ticked by default. Remove those that are not relevant.
- On an existing system you see which standard inspections exist (✓) and which are missing. Tick and save to create them.
- The intervals are indicative. Adjust them to the installation's O&M documentation and service agreement.
Søket etter leverandørdata henter også v:
The search for supplier data also fetches the maintenance the manufacturer recommends for the model (e.g. filter change, cleaning, service), with interval.

- Tick the ones you want to follow up and save. They are created as inspections of the type «Supplier recommendation», with the first deadline in 30 days.
- For components the inspection is linked to the system, with the component code in the name.
- Check against the O&M documentation. Without Google search the recommendations are general and less reliable.
Kostnad per m² og areal målt på tegning: Cost per m² and area measured on drawing
For bygningsdeler der kostnaden naturlig:
For building elements where cost is naturally calculated per m² (roof, façade, floors, interior surfaces, asphalt), you can choose «Area × price per m²».

- Enter the area, or tap «Measure area on drawing». Choose a drawing, draw one or more surfaces (click the corners, finish on the first point) and tap «Use». The surfaces are added up and saved, so you can change the measurement later.
- The drawing must have a scale. If it does not, set it first (click two points with a known distance).
- The replacement cost becomes area × price per m² × factor. Use the factor for roof pitch (a floor plan shows the horizontal surface), waste or site setup.
- The cost is price-adjusted and its present value calculated like other costs.
I NS 3451 er hovedgruppe 1 dokumentasjon:
In NS 3451, main group 1 is documentation, not physical systems: 10 Building documentation, 11 Documents for management, 12 Legal and public documents, 13 Site, 14 Dimensioning, 15 Environment, 16 Drawings, plans and maps, 17 Fire documentation, 18 Safety and 19 Operation and maintenance.

- Documents are registered under «Documents» and get an NS 3451 code automatically from the document type (e.g. fire strategy → 17, O&M → 19, completion certificate → 12). The code can be overridden in the document.
- In «Systems and components (TFM)», group 1 is shown as an overview of the property's documents, sorted by 10–19, so that the whole NS 3451 structure is in one place.
Knappen går gjennom eiendommen og foresl:
The button goes through the property and suggests inspections missing from the inspection plan. It creates nothing until you have chosen and tapped «Create selected».

- Fixed inspections for the property: fire safety documentation, fire safety round, coordination with tenants, coordinated fire drill, owner's internal control, obtaining tenants' documentation, energy certificate, condition assessment, exterior safety round, snow and ice, radon.
- Standard inspections for each registered system (e.g. annual inspection and monthly self-inspection of the fire alarm), where they are missing.
- Inspections that already exist are not shown. The button is therefore safe to use at any time – e.g. after registering new systems, or after the app has received new inspection templates.
- You choose the first deadline for the new inspections. If an inspection was carried out earlier, record it afterwards with «Completed», so the next deadline is calculated correctly.
Systemkoden fra NS 3451, normalt tre sif: The system code from NS 3451, normally three digits (e.g. 360 air handling, 443 emergency lighting). The code determines the main group the system is shown under, and which service life is suggested.
Skiller like systemer i samme bygg fra h: Distinguishes identical systems in the same building: 360.001, 360.002 etc. Suggested automatically.
Valgfri lokaliseringskode foran systemko: Optional location code before the system code, e.g. +B01, when a property has several buildings.
To bokstaver som sier hva komponenten er: Two letters saying what the component is, e.g. JV fan, JP pump, RT temperature sensor, DB fire door. Start typing to get suggestions.
Valgfri kode etter %-tegnet som angir pr: Optional code after the % sign indicating the product type, e.g. from the supplier's O&M documentation.
Antall år fra installert år til forvente:
Number of years from the installation year to expected replacement. The hint below the field shows the technical and functional service life from NS 3451, and the buttons enter the middle value.

For components: leave the field empty if the component is to be replaced together with the system.
Året systemet eller komponenten ble inst: The year the system or component was installed or last replaced. Together with the service life it gives the replacement year.
Bruk dette hvis utskiftingen er bestemt: Use this if the replacement has been set for a different year than the calculated one, for example because it is coordinated with a refurbishment.
Hva utskiftingen koster i dag, eks. mva,:
What the replacement costs today, excl. VAT, including installation.

At system level this is the central cost (control panel, controls, cabling etc.). The component costs are added automatically, so the sum becomes the system's total replacement cost.
Året kostnaden er anslått i. Beløpet pri: The year the cost was estimated in. The amount is price-adjusted with the CPI from then up to the replacement year.
Produsent og modell, f.eks. «Swegon GOLD: Manufacturer and model, e.g. «Swegon GOLD RX 25». The more precise, the better the results of the supplier data search.
TG0 ingen avvik · TG1 mindre avvik · TG2: TG0 no deviations · TG1 minor deviations · TG2 significant deviations · TG3 serious deviations · TGIU not examined. See the description below the field for the chosen grade.
Hvor alvorlige følgene kan bli: KG0 inge: How serious the consequences may be: KG0 none, KG1 small, KG2 medium, KG3 major. Used together with TG2, TG3 and TGIU.
Hvem som skal sørge for vedlikehold elle: Who must take care of maintenance or repair: owner, tenant or a supplier. For tenants this normally follows the split in the lease.
Risikoklasse 1–6 etter byggteknisk forsk: Risk class 1–6 under the Norwegian building regulations, based on use and who is in the building. Affects the fire protection requirements.
Brannklasse 1–4 ut fra konsekvensene av: Fire class 1–4 based on the consequences of a fire. Normally stated in the fire strategy.
Særskilte brannobjekter etter brann- og: Special fire objects under the Norwegian Fire and Explosion Prevention Act § 13 are inspected by the fire service and have stricter documentation requirements.
Navn og utgave på kontraktsdokumentet de:
Name and edition of the lease document you have used, e.g. «Standard bare-house lease for commercial buildings, 2025». The field is for information.

It is «Lease type» above that governs the split of responsibility and which obligations the tenant gets. The split can be adjusted item by item in the table «Split of responsibility under the lease» on the tenant.
Hvordan leiekontrakten fastsetter leieta: How the lease fixes the tenant's share of the common area: a fixed number of m², a percentage of the common area or a percentage add-on to their own area. Used to calculate over- or under-coverage.
Hvor ofte kontrollen skal gjøres. Neste: How often the inspection must be done. The next deadline is calculated automatically when the inspection is recorded as completed.
Hvor raskt avviket må lukkes. Høy alvorl: How quickly the deviation must be closed. High severity gives a shorter default deadline and is shown first in the lists.
Hvor mange måneder før avtaleutløp du vi: How many months before the lease expires you want a reminder to renew or terminate.
